show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/mV28aY
show.description: A brutally injured young man, Kian, rises from near death to infiltrate Mumbai’s deadliest gang, seeking revenge for his family’s murder only to discover that the woman he trusts and serves is the very mastermind behind his destruction.
